integrity: Standalone checker corroborates selected rational minors and numerical eigenvalues; analytic proof is separate and references established zero theorems.
scientific_limitations: The spectral theorem assumes a>0 and theta>1; the weighted L2 spectral rate does not assert uniform total-variation convergence. Existence of the positive eigenfunction and reality/simplicity of all deformed-exponential zeros are credited prior inputs. Full historical priority and external mathematical validation are unestablished.
title: Complete positive spectrum and sharp modal relaxation for an expanding conditioned moving average
